theater: 杜羅河下游與北葡萄牙

battle.name: 自由派戰爭
battle.theater: 杜羅河下游與北葡萄牙
battle.brief: 一八二八年五月，佩德羅四世一方在波多起兵，米格爾一世由三級制憲會議加冕為國王，葡國內戰自此開打。自由派守住杜羅河兩岸的波多與加亞，靠英法援助與海運補給抵禦米格爾軍圍城，到一八三四年阿塞塞拉一役後以埃沃拉蒙特協定收束。長槍在這場戰爭裡只剩遺物地位，多見於徵召民兵與游擊隊手中。

kit.name: 長槍
kit.history: 方陣的長矛讓火槍隊站在後面。密西西比之後，長矛和火槍一起站住了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是同一個王國的兩種政治主張。自由派以流亡在亞速爾群島特雷西拉島的佩德羅四世為國王，其女兒瑪麗亞二世是未成年繼承人，自由派政府的實際樞紐是元帥薩爾達尼亞與特雷西拉公爵，據點設在波多與加亞。米格爾派以米格爾一世為國王，由一八二八年五月召集的三級制憲會議加冕，主權歸於他本人，宮廷與南方貴族、教會、鄉村構成其社會基礎。雙方的軍事骨幹都是葡萄牙王國自身的軍隊：一八二八年五月十八日，波多守軍宣布效忠佩德羅四世與一八二六年憲章，自由派自此有了地盤與軍械；里斯本與南部各城的守軍則多數仍效忠米格爾，國民軍、民兵與鄉村武裝多在米格爾一方。自由派方面的外來援軍包括英國分遣隊與志願者、法國分遣隊與海軍中隊、西班牙一八三三年起派出的埃斯帕特羅軍團，以及一八三二年由比利時志願者組成、指揮官為勒沙利耶的比利時獵兵團，人數在一千至一千五百之間。米格爾一方得到教宗國與天主教會的支持，俄羅斯亦提供外交與道義上的背書。
countriesEn: The two sides were two political claims upon the same kingdom. The Liberals took their king from the exile court of Pedro IV on the island of Terceira in the Azores, with his daughter Maria II as a minor heir; the practical pivots of the Liberal government were Marshal Saldanha and the Duke of Terceira, and their strongholds were Porto and Vila Nova de Gaia. The Miguelists had Miguel I as king, crowned by the traditional estates Cortes convened in May 1828, sovereignty resting in his own person, with the court, the southern nobility, the Church and the countryside forming his social base. The military backbone on both sides was the Portuguese army itself. On 18 May 1828 the garrison of Porto declared its loyalty to Pedro IV and the Constitutional Charter of 1826, which gave the Liberals territory and ordnance; the garrisons of Lisbon and the southern towns for the most part remained loyal to Miguel, and the national guard, the militia and the country detachments were mostly on his side. Foreign support for the Liberals included British detachments and volunteers, a French detachment and naval squadron, the Spanish corps under Espartero sent from 1833, and the corps of Belgian riflemen formed in 1832 from volunteers and commanded by Lecharlier, numbering between one thousand and one thousand five hundred men. The Miguelists had the backing of the Papal States and the Catholic Church, and Russia gave them diplomatic and moral cover.
people: 佩德羅四世是自由派的名義國君，一八二六年以《一八二六年憲章》劃出君主立憲的框架，一八二八年四月離開葡萄牙前往巴西，一年後再由巴西返回歐洲，在亞速爾群島組閣，最終於一八三二年七月八日在明代洛登陸並進入波多。米格爾一世自一八二八年二月回國就攝政，五月解散兩院並召開傳統制憲會議，取得絕對王位，這場衝突因此被稱為兩兄弟之戰。軍事上，特雷西拉公爵是自由派最銳利的一把刀，他自一八三三年六月率軍在法魯登陸，經阿連特茹一路北上，七月二十四日進入里斯本；薩爾達尼亞元帥在最後一年的攻勢中擔任主攻；英國海軍少將拿破，即查爾斯·納皮爾，化名卡洛斯·德·蓬扎，率分遣艦隊於一八三三年七月五日在聖文森特角擊敗米格爾派分遣隊；一八三二年率艦隊在明代洛護送登陸的英國海軍上將喬治·薩托里烏斯，以及駐紮杜羅河的奧瑞斯特斯號艦長威廉·格拉斯科也在場。米格爾一方以蒙塔萊格雷子爵、聖馬爾塔子爵、卡達瓦爾公爵、波瓦什將軍與布爾蒙元帥率軍圍城；阿爾加夫山區的游擊隊首領雷梅克西多在聖馬科斯山一帶作戰多年。米格爾派在最後一役的指揮官是蒙塔萊格雷子爵。自由派一方，阿萊梅達·加雷特與亞歷山大·埃爾庫拉諾在圍城之中留下記錄，司法大臣若阿基姆·安托尼奧·阿吉亞爾則主持了收束戰爭的交涉。
peopleEn: Pedro IV was the nominal sovereign of the Liberals. He drew up the Constitutional Charter of 1826 as a constitutional framework, left Portugal for Brazil in April 1828, returned to Europe a year later and set up his government in the Azores, and on 8 July 1832 he landed at Mindelo and entered Porto. Miguel I returned from abroad in February 1828 to take up the regency, dissolved both chambers in May and called the traditional Cortes, which gave him absolute kingship; the conflict was accordingly known as the war of the two brothers. In the field the Duke of Terceira was the sharpest instrument on the Liberal side: he landed at Faro in June 1833, marched north through the Alentejo and entered Lisbon on 24 July. Marshal Saldanha led the offensives of the final year. The British naval officer Charles Napier, who used the alias Carlos de Ponza, destroyed the Miguelist squadron at Cape St Vincent on 5 July 1833. George Sartorius led the naval covering of the landing at Mindelo in 1832, and William Nugent Glascock, commanding HMS Orestes, lay in the Douro between the two sides. On the Miguelist side the siege was directed by the Viscount of Montalegre, the Viscount of Santa Marta, the Duke of Cadaval, General Póvoas and Marshal de Bourmont. In the mountains of the Algarve the guerrilla leader Remexido fought for years around the Serra de São Marcos. The Miguelist army in the last engagement of the war was commanded by the Viscount of Montalegre. On the Liberal side Almeida Garrett and Alexandre Herculano left their record of the siege from inside it, and Joaquim António de Aguiar, the minister of justice, conducted the negotiations that closed the war.
kits: 長槍在這場戰爭裡的位置是遺物加徵召時的湊合裝備。一八二八年的葡萄牙線式步兵早已不列長槍，方陣長矛護住後面火槍隊的時代在十七、十八世紀之交就結束了；本戰爭中真正決定陣地的，是滑膛燧發步槍與野砲。自由派在波多據守時使用一八二六年式的滑膛燧發步槍配刺刀，米格爾派的步兵多帶一七九〇年代至一八〇〇年代較舊的同類火器，兩者的射程與精度相去不遠，差距主要出現在砲兵與後勤。砲兵是圍城戰的主角：米格爾軍在杜羅河兩岸修成連續的砲兵包圍線，一八三三年七月英國軍用地形圖仍標出加亞一側卡達爾高地的砲位，正對自由派的塞拉杜皮亞爾要塞，其中架有一門派克漢式長射程砲；一八三四年五月十六日阿塞塞拉一役，雙方投入的野砲約為自由派十一門對米格爾派十二門，說明野砲在當時仍是營級火力的骨幹。海上方面，英國分遣艦隊曾駛入杜羅河，奧瑞斯特斯號夾在雙方之間；一八三一年法國分遣隊在塔霍斯河口攻擊米格爾派封鎖艦隊，也為自由派解開了特雷西拉島的封鎖。長槍真正還在場的場合，是那些來不及領到火器的徵召單位：米格爾派的地方營與城鎮民兵、部分鄉村武裝以削尖的長矛、木叉與農具對付刺刀，阿爾加夫山區的游擊隊亦然；這些矛沒有站進方陣，而是混在人堆裡，替沒有槍的人擋住一輪衝鋒。
kitsEn: The place of the pike in this war was that of a relic and of an improvised arm of the hastily raised. Portuguese line infantry had long since abandoned the pike; the age when the pike sheltered the musketeers behind it had ended in the turn of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries. What really decided positions here was the smoothbore flintlock musket and the field gun. The Liberals defending Porto used smoothbore flintlock muskets of the 1826 pattern with bayonets, while Miguelist infantry carried older muskets of the 1790s and 1800s; the difference in range and accuracy between the two was slight, and the real gap lay in the artillery and in logistics. The guns were the protagonists of the siege: the Miguelist army built a continuous artillery perimeter on both banks of the Douro, and a British topographical map of July 1833 still marks the battery positions on the heights of Candal on the Gaia side, facing the Liberal position at the Serra do Pilar, where a Paixhans long-range piece stood. At the battle of Asseiceira on 16 May 1834 the field guns engaged were about eleven on the Liberal side against twelve on the Miguelist side, which shows that the field gun was still the backbone of brigade-scale firepower. At sea, a British squadron entered the Douro, HMS Orestes lying between the two sides; in 1831 a French detachment attacked the Miguelist blockading squadron at the mouth of the Tagus, which also broke the blockade of the island of Terceira. The pike was really still present only among the units raised too hastily to be issued firearms: the Miguelist ordinary levies, the town militias and part of the country armed bands fought with sharpened poles, wooden forks and farm implements against bayonets, and the guerrillas of the Algarve did the same. These pikes did not stand in a formation; they were mixed into a crowd, holding back a single rush on behalf of men who had no gun.
tactics: 米格爾派的戰法是圍城加消耗：把波多與加亞從陸路切斷，用固定砲位從杜羅河兩岸高地上射擊城區，再以封鎖切斷河海運輸，等待城內糧秣與彈藥耗盡。自由派則把波多城牆與塞拉杜皮亞爾要塞當作堡壘，把杜羅河與英國分遣艦隊當作補給線，並靠外國志願者維持市內秩序；米格爾軍雖以約六萬人包圍約一萬二千人的被圍軍，卻不敢強攻，圍城因此拖成一年多。從地形看，杜羅河兩岸陡峭、橋樑有限，河流本身就是最好的防禦線；一八三二年七月英國海軍與志願者在明代洛登陸，靠的正是這一點。一八三三年的轉折出現在南部：特雷西拉公爵利用米格爾派主力黏在波多、南部兵力空虛，從法魯登陸後沿阿連特茹海岸北上，七月二十四日進軍里斯本，迫使米格爾回兵；接著拿破的艦隊在聖文森特角摧毀對方分遣隊，切斷海運。自由派在阿爾加夫的戰事則完全是游擊戰：雷梅克西多的小隊在聖馬科斯山一帶依地形襲擊護送隊與稅站。最後一役阿塞塞拉，自由派以三縱隊自托馬爾方向攻擊，頂住砲火與騎兵衝鋒後奪下陣地；五月二十六日的埃沃拉蒙特協定終止了流血。
tacticsEn: The Miguelist method was siege plus exhaustion: to cut Porto and Gaia off by land, to shell the city from fixed batteries on the heights above both banks of the Douro, to sever river and sea supply through the blockade, and then to wait for the grain and ammunition inside the city to run out. The Liberals treated the walls of Porto and the fort of the Serra do Pilar as their redoubt, the Douro and the British squadron as their supply line, and relied on foreign volunteers to keep order inside the city. The Miguelist army, some sixty thousand men surrounding a garrison of about twelve thousand, never dared to storm the place, and the siege therefore dragged on for more than a year. Terrain favoured the defenders: the Douro has steep banks and few bridges, and the river itself was the best defensive line; the British naval detachment and the volunteers landed at Mindelo in July 1832 precisely because of that. The turning point of 1833 lay in the south. The Duke of Terceira exploited the fact that the Miguelist main body was pinned down at Porto and the south was empty: he landed at Faro, marched north along the coast of the Alentejo and entered Lisbon on 24 July, forcing Miguel to draw his troops back; Napier's squadron then destroyed the Miguelist squadron at Cape St Vincent and cut the sea route. In the Algarve the Liberal war was fought entirely as a guerrilla campaign: Remexido's bands used the terrain of the Serra de São Marcos to ambush convoys and tax posts. At Asseiceira the Liberals attacked in three columns from the direction of Tomar, stood up under artillery fire and cavalry charges and carried the position; the Concession of Evoramonte on 26 May ended the bloodshed.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。戰爭自一八二八年五月十八日波多守軍宣布效忠起算，到一八三四年五月二十六日埃沃拉蒙特協定為止，前後約六年。一八二九年八月十一日的普雷亞達維多利亞戰役是米格爾派在早期的一次得手；一八三一年在塔霍斯河口，英法分遣艦隊擊毀米格爾派用來封鎖特雷西拉島的艦隊；一八三二年七月八日自由派在明代洛登陸，七月二十三日費雷拉橋交戰；波多圍城自一八三二年七月延續到一八三三年八月，被圍的自由派軍約一萬二千人，圍城方投入約六萬人。一八三三年七月五日聖文森特角海戰，七月二十四日里斯本易手；同年年底瑪麗亞二世被宣布為女王，佩德羅任攝政；自由派在阿爾塞爾多沙爾一役受挫。一八三四年五月十六日阿塞塞拉一役，自由派投入步兵六千以上、騎兵約五百、野砲約十一門；米格爾派步兵五千五百、騎兵五百、野砲十二門，損失約二千九百人傷亡並有一千四百人被俘，自由派損失約四百人傷亡；米格爾派的總兵力約一萬八千人。比利時獵兵團志願者為一千至一千五百人。五月二十六日簽訂埃沃拉蒙特協定，佩德羅同年九月二十四日去世；米格爾派的武裝團體在南部山區一直活動到一八四〇年代。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The war is counted from 18 May 1828, when the garrison of Porto declared its loyalty, to the Concession of Evoramonte on 26 May 1834, a matter of about six years. The battle of Praia da Vitória on 11 August 1829 was an early success for the Miguelists. In 1831, at the mouth of the Tagus, British and French squadrons destroyed the Miguelist ships blockading the island of Terceira. On 8 July 1832 the Liberals landed at Mindelo, and there was a fight at the bridge of Ferreira on 23 July. The siege of Porto lasted from July 1832 to August 1833, with about twelve thousand Liberals besieged and about sixty thousand men invested. There was a naval action off Cape St Vincent on 5 July 1833, and Lisbon changed hands on 24 July. Toward the end of that year Maria II was proclaimed queen and Pedro became regent; the Liberals suffered a reverse at Alcácer do Sal. At Asseiceira on 16 May 1834 the Liberals committed more than six thousand infantry, about five hundred cavalry and about eleven field guns; the Miguelists had five thousand five hundred infantry, five hundred cavalry and twelve guns, losing about two thousand nine hundred men killed or wounded with about one thousand four hundred taken prisoner, against about four hundred casualties on the Liberal side. The Miguelist field army numbered about eighteen thousand men. The Belgian rifle corps counted between one thousand and one thousand five hundred volunteers. The Convention of Evoramonte was signed on 26 May; Pedro died on 24 September of the same year; and Miguelist bands remained active in the southern mountains into the 1840s.
cause: 打起來的原因是王位繼承與憲制之爭。一八二六年約翰六世去世，長子佩德羅已是巴西皇帝並且在同年宣佈巴西獨立，弟弟米格爾主張佩德羅既已接受外國王冠，按葡王室的繼承法規就自動放棄了葡萄牙王位，兩兄弟各自背靠一整套傳統與新制度的合法性。佩德羅的《一八二六年憲章》試圖折衷：保留國王對立法的絕對否決權，設上下兩院，並讓天主教與貴族在國家中保有位置。這份折衷令兩邊都不滿，傳統派與教會尤其不能接受一八二二年憲法所帶來的自由派改革；而法國一八二三年波旁復辟、西班牙清除拿破崙時期制度的做法，更讓葡國貴族相信舊秩序仍有可能回歸。一八二八年二月米格爾回國，原本只是要宣誓效忠憲章並就任攝政，卻在支持者裹挾下解散兩院，五月召開三級制憲會議把自己的絕對王位合法化，波多守軍隨即以整座城為依托起兵反抗。外因是歐洲的風向：法國七月革命與比利時革命之後，英法兩國樂於見到一個親法的葡萄牙自由政府，而俄羅斯與教宗國則願意支持秩序的守護者米格爾，於是這場本國內戰變成了國際角力。
causeEn: The cause was a dispute over succession and over the constitution. When John VI died in 1826 his elder son Pedro was already Emperor of Brazil and had declared Brazilian independence in the same year, and his younger brother Miguel argued that by accepting a foreign crown Pedro had automatically forfeited the Portuguese crown under the succession rules of the house; each brother thus backed a whole system of legitimacy, traditional on one side and new on the other. Pedro's Constitutional Charter of 1826 was an attempted compromise: it kept the king's absolute veto over legislation, set up two chambers, and gave the Church and the nobility a place in the state. The compromise satisfied neither side, and the traditionalists and the Church in particular could not accept the liberal reforms that had followed the Constitution of 1822; the Bourbon restoration in France in 1823 and the removal of Napoleonic institutions in Spain reinforced the belief in the Portuguese nobility that the old order might yet return. Miguel came back in February 1828 ostensibly to take the oath to the Charter and to assume the regency, but under pressure from his supporters he dissolved both chambers and in May summoned the estates Cortes to legitimate his absolute kingship, and the garrison of Porto rose in revolt with the whole city behind it. The external cause was the weather of Europe: after the July Revolution in France and the Belgian Revolution, Britain and France were glad to see a pro-French Liberal government in Lisbon, while Russia and the Papal States were willing to back Miguel as the guardian of order, so that a civil war inside Portugal turned into an international contest.
impact: 戰爭的結果重塑了葡萄牙的國家形式。米格爾一系退位，自由派重新頒布一八二六年憲章，君主立憲在葡國恢復，一八三六年又按自由派的心願改為更寬鬆的憲章；此後大十九世紀，葡國政治始終在左翼自由派與右翼傳統派之間擺動，鎮壓與反鎮壓成為常態。佩德羅在戰後沒收所有曾在米格爾方面任職者的產業，並解散修道院、沒收教產，直接令教廷關係中斷近八年，直到一八四一年才恢復。對外，這場戰爭拉開了葡萄牙與巴西的距離：佩德羅兩度以巴西為基地作戰，葡巴共體的構想就此收場，巴西轉而尋找自己的道路，佩德羅二世的巴西走上獨立外交。經濟上，六年內戰與封鎖切斷了葡國與英國的傳統轉口貿易，自由派政府為重建港口與財政而全面靠向英國，於是英國資本與法國的七月王朝模式同時成為葡國的參照。文化上，這場戰爭產生了大量文學與記述，圍城期的書信、日記與小說至今仍是研究一八三〇年代歐洲的原始材料；米格爾派在阿爾加夫的游擊隊首領雷梅克西多更成為反對派記憶中的傳說人物，說明絕對主義的鄉村社會並未因和約而消失。
impactEn: The outcome reshaped the form of the Portuguese state. The Miguelist line was pushed aside, the Liberals restored the Constitutional Charter of 1826, constitutional monarchy returned, and in 1836 the charter was revised along more liberal lines; for the rest of the nineteenth century Portuguese politics swung between a liberal left and a traditionalist right, with repression and counter-repression as regular features. Pedro confiscated the property of everyone who had served under Miguel and suppressed the religious houses with their estates, which broke relations with Rome for close to eight years until 1841. Abroad, the war pushed Portugal and Brazil apart: Pedro fought twice from Brazil as his base, the idea of a union of the two crowns was thereby abandoned, and Brazil went looking for its own path, the Brazil of Pedro II pursuing an independent diplomacy. Economically, six years of civil war and blockade cut the traditional transit trade between Portugal and Britain, and the Liberal government, needing to rebuild ports and credit, turned wholly towards Britain, so that British capital and the French July Monarchy model both became Portuguese references. Culturally the war produced a large body of literature and record: the letters, diaries and novels of the siege remain primary material for the study of 1830s Europe, and Remexido, the guerrilla chief of the Algarve, became a legendary figure in the memory of the opposition, showing that the absolutist village society had not disappeared with the peace.
result: 米格爾派在阿塞塞拉一役失去最後一次機會：一八三四年五月十六日他本人仍在營中，軍隊約一萬八千人，砲兵與騎兵配備齊全，卻被自由派以縱隊正面擊潰，損失慘重，殘部退向戈萊甘，翌日佩德羅抱病趕到陣線上。戰爭在軍事上至此結束，在政治上以五月二十六日的埃沃拉蒙特協定收束：米格爾放棄一切王位主張，獲得一筆年金並被確定流放，佩德羅恢復憲章，十三歲的瑪麗亞二世回到祖國登基，佩德羅任攝政。之後數年仍不乾淨：米格爾派在阿爾加夫與山區的武裝團體持續作戰，部分游擊隊直到一八四〇年代仍在活動；佩德羅同年九月二十四日去世；一八三四年之後葡國加入英法西組成的四方同盟，歐洲協調的框架暫時重新穩住。自由派也付出代價：國家財政被戰爭掏空，傳統派在大選中屢次回升，而此後二十年的政治拉鋸，源頭正落在這六年的分裂上；同時，圍城期所考驗出的城防砲兵運用，固定砲位、封鎖河海、以砲火逼守軍耗盡，成為此後歐洲圍城戰的教科素材。
resultEn: The Miguelists lost their last chance at Asseiceira: on 16 May 1834 Miguel was still with the army, which numbered about eighteen thousand men with its guns and cavalry in place, but it was broken frontally by the Liberal columns at heavy cost, and the remnants fell back towards Golegã, where Pedro arrived ill on the following day. Militarily the war ended there; politically it was closed by the Concession of Evoramonte on 26 May: Miguel renounced every claim to the throne, was granted an annual pension and was definitively exiled, Pedro restored the charter, and the thirteen-year-old Maria II returned to her country and was crowned, with Pedro as regent. The settlement did not make the country clean afterwards: Miguelist bands kept fighting in the Algarve and the mountains, and some guerrilla groups remained active into the 1840s; Pedro died on 24 September of the same year; and after 1834 Portugal entered the Quadruple Alliance with Britain, France and Spain, which restored the European balance for a time. The Liberals paid a price too: the war emptied the treasury, the traditionalists returned repeatedly to electoral strength, and the political tug of war of the following twenty years has its origin precisely in these six years of division. At the same time the siege tested the use of artillery in the defence and reduction of towns, fixed batteries, blockade of river and sea, and guns worn down a garrison's supplies, and that experience passed into the textbooks of European siegecraft of the following decades.
